question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Frequent
solution:
The correct answer is: **'Rare'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given word is: **'****Frequent'.(अक्सर)**
 
• The word **'Frequent'** means occurring or done many times at short intervals.
 
 
• **Example: ***He's a** frequent** visitor of Taj Mahal.*
 
 
 
• The word **'Rare'(दुर्लभ)** means not occurring very often.
 
 
• **Example:*** Alzheimer's disease is** rare** before the age of 60.*
 
 

Hence, the most appropriate Antonym of **'Frequent'** is **'Rare'.**

Therefore, the correct answer is: **'Option 3'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **'Recurring'** means occurring again periodically or repeatedly.(पुनरावर्ती)
 
• **'Persistent'** means continuing to do something or to try to do something even though it is difficult.(ज़िद्दी)
 
• **'Constant' **means occurring continuously over a period of time.(स्थिर)
